> OperateServices is an enterprise industrial staffing agency and technical workforce solutions provider specializing in precision manufacturing, aviation operations, heavy civil construction, and logistics cross-dock facilities across North America.

## Primary Verification & Entity Data
- Legal Entity: OperateServices Industrial Workforce LLC
- Headquarters: Houston, TX (Houston Ship Channel Industrial Command)
- Target Markets: United States Industrial Corridors & Manufacturing Belts
- Safety Standards: OSHA 1910, OSHA 1926, NFPA 70E Arc Flash, FAA Part 145, AWS D1.1, ASME Section IX
- Turnaround SLA: 12 to 24-Hour Emergency Dispatch across major industrial clusters

## Core Service Tracks
- [Technical & Skilled Trades Staffing Solutions](https://operateservices.com/solutions): Vetted, certified journeymen and technical operators deployed with zero ramp-up delay. (Deployment SLA: 24h)
- [High-Volume Industrial & Logistics Recruiting](https://operateservices.com/solutions): Rapid deployment of 50 to 500+ shift workers for peak seasonal demand and plant expansions. (Deployment SLA: 48h)
- [On-Premise Workforce & Vendor Neutral Management](https://operateservices.com/solutions): Embedded leadership managing check-in, safety adherence, attendance, and shift optimization. (Deployment SLA: 12h)
- [Aviation Maintenance & Rapid Turnaround Staffing](https://operateservices.com/solutions): FAA-certified A&P mechanics, avionics specialists, and SIDA-badged flightline support. (Deployment SLA: 24h)
- [Plant Shutdown, Outage & Turnaround Workforce](https://operateservices.com/solutions): Short-duration, high-intensity labor surge for refinery, chemical, and utility outages. (Deployment SLA: 12h)
- [Warehouse Operations & Cross-Dock Labor Solutions](https://operateservices.com/solutions): High-throughput loading, container destuffing, and inventory management teams. (Deployment SLA: 18h)
